scientific_integrity: Proof derives the global bound and exact attaining witness, with finite checker used only as a supplementary test. Historical-priority uncertainty and lack of independent audit are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The result is planar, applies to standard coordinate ell_p for p>2, and imports Meyer's parallelogram-reduction lemma and Hanner's inequality; no full characterization of equality sets or higher-dimensional analogue is claimed.
title: Sharp off-diagonal \(\ell_p\) Hausdorff convexification for planar Minkowski sums
